content: While tinkering with the new dark elemetal ingots, you noticed the material warps space around it.
You quickly realized that making weapons or equipment out of this material won't bring out the full potential of this material.
Instead, tools that deal with storage seems to be a better fit for this material.
A simple bucket made out of Dark Elemetal turned out to be a significant improvement.
The space warping attributes of this metal allows the bucket to hold more than it should be able to.
The Dark Elemetal Bucket is able to store up to 4 of any liquid at once.
While holding the bucket in your main hand, using 'Sneak + Scroll', you can swap between the available slots.
Because the insides of the bucket are connected to a different space, you cannot use this bucket to relocate living creatures.
